description: Prepared Payment plus high-sample production repeat passed the production medium gate 23/23 with zero unstable suites and zero unstable cases.
The old 20-sample medium repeat is insufficient for production gate evidence; min_case_samples=60 rejects undersampled latency cases before stability and threshold checks can be trusted.
High-sample production stability median suite p95: tpcc 1.822 ms, memtier 0.900 ms, tsbs 1.315 ms, ldbc 1.194 ms, chbench 0.684 ms; all suites and cases stable.

Next production-readiness iteration should add PgWire/JDBC smoke coverage for production benchmark schemas and metadata, because official BenchBase/TPC-C, LDBC, and CH-benCHmark compatibility depends on driver/protocol behavior beyond HTTP workloads.
